# Let's verify a known optimal Golomb ruler with 11 marks
# Known optimal: 0, 1, 4, 13, 28, 33, 47, 54, 64, 70, 72

ruler = [0, 1, 4, 13, 28, 33, 47, 54, 64, 70, 72]

# Check all pairwise distances are unique
distances = []
for i in range(len(ruler)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(ruler)):
        d = ruler[j] - ruler[i]
        distances.append(d)

print(f"Number of marks: {len(ruler)}")
print(f"Number of distances: {len(distances)}")
print(f"Unique distances: {len(set(distances))}")
print(f"All unique: {len(distances) == len(set(distances))}")
